description.value: The Boston-headquartered company sells a data lake analytics platform built on the open-source Trino query engine. Its pitch centers on reducing data silos and vendor lock-in.
Starburst, the data analytics company built on open-source Trino, was founded in 2017 and describes itself as remote-first.

product_description.value: Starburst offers a full-featured data lake analytics platform, built on open-source Trino. It lets customers find, organize and use data without large migration projects.
Starburst Galaxy is its managed cloud service, and it also sells a self-managed Enterprise edition for on-premises and hybrid deployments. Both are built on open-source Trino.

business_model_description.value: Credit-based, consumption-style pricing for the managed Starburst Galaxy service, with pay-as-you-go billing and no upfront commitment (Pro roughly $0.50 per credit, Enterprise $0.75, Mission-Critical $1.00). The self-managed Enterprise edition is sold through sales with custom pricing.

customer_description.value: More than 200 leading organizations trust the company, per its pitch as quoted on Built In.
